chapter.verse: Pasian in tang lai-a kamsangte tungah, i pute pate kiangah atuam atuamin thu a piak kikkik khit ciangin, a nunung bel hih nite-ah ama Tapa tungah eite thu hong pia zo hi. Tua a Tapa na khempeuh luah dingin a koih zo hi; ama tungah zong leitung a piangsak hi.
Tua a Ta in Pasian’ vangliatna meel leh pianlim hi a, ama vangliatna tawh na khempeuh kipin, eite mawhnate amahmah in a sian’sak khit ciangin, a sang mun vangliatna ziat lamah tu-in a om hi.
Vantungmite a ngah uh min sangin a phazaw min a ngah mah bangin vantungmite sangin a lianzaw mi ahi hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh: “Nang in ka Tapa na hi hi, Tuni-in na Pa ka suak zo hi,” ci-in ahi zongin, “Keimah in ama Pa ka hi ding hi, Amah in zong ka Tapa ahi ding hi,” ci-in ahi zongin a kua vantungmi kiangah khatvei beek thupia ngei ahi hiam?
Lam khat panin a Tapa upa leitungah a hong sawl ciangin: “Pasian’ vantungmi khempeuh in bokin Amah a bia uh hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Lam khat panin: “Ama vantungmite in huih nung bang ahi zongin, A nasemte meikuang bang ahi zongin a piangsak hi,” ci-in vantungmite ngaihsunin a gen hi.
A Tapa thu ahih leh: “Pasian aw, na tokhom in A om tawntung tokhom ahi hi, Dikna ahi ukna Ciang in Na gam ukna ciang ahi hi.

Nang in dikna thu na deih a, Gitlohna thu na mudah hi; Tua ahih ciangin nangma Pasian ahi Pasian in, Nangma lawmte khempeuh sangin Nang hong pahtawi zaw-in, Lungdamna sathau tawh hong nilh zo hi,” a ci hi.
Khatvei: “Topa aw, nang in a kipat cilin Leitung bul na piangsak hi; Vantung zong na khut tawh Na bawl na ahi hi.
Tuate a kisiat ding uh hangin, Nang na om tawntung ding hi; Tuate puan bangin a tul ding hi.
Amaute puan bangin na zial ding hi, Amaute puan bangin a kikheel ding uh hi. Nang na hih leh, na kikheel ngei kei ding hi, Na nuntakna a bei ngei kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua tham loin: “Na galte khempeuh na khe nuai-ah Ka koih matengin, Ka ziat lamah na tu in,” ci a, kua vantungmi khatvei beek thupia ngei ahi hiam?
Vantungmite khempeuh in gupkhiatna luah ding mite kem dingun, sawltak nasem khate hilo ahi uh hiam?
